# **<u>Antimony Market Overview</u>** 

##### **Price Review** 

The antimony market appeared to be in clam in February 2013. Due to Spring Festival holidays in February, the transaction of antimony market was not active. Although the market strongly expected the price to grow up, the market demand remained weak. Quotations of domestic antimony ingot (2#) and antimony oxide (99.5%) were maintained in the range of 67,000-68,000yuan/t and 60,000-62,000yuan/t at most of time. 

After Spring Festival, domestic market was not positive to give quotation. Partial suppliers just returned to market and wanted to watch the market tendency to determine how to give quotation. In later February, antimony ingot suppliers raised ex-work quotation for antimony ingot (2#) to 68,000-69,000yuan/t, up by 1,000yuan/t compared with that before Spring Festival. However, the main-stream quotation of antimony oxide (99.5%) was 60,000-62,000yuan/t, being almost the same with that before Spring Festival. Affected by increasing antimony ingot price, some antimony oxide suppliers slightly raised quotation. There were some enquiries in market, but most purchasers just aimed to get price tendency, rather than to purc

hase products. Sellers and buyers just returned to market and held watching attitude for future market. Chinese exporter maintained the quotation for exported antimony ingot (2#) in the range of US$11,500-11,600/t (FOB), being equal with that before Spring Festival. Currently, the export quotation of antimony oxide (99.5%) is US$9,800-9,900/t (FOB), up by US$100/t. Chinese exporters just returned to market. There were some enquires, but order forms were few. The overseas market is holding watching and waiting attitude to watch any changes in Chinese market. In accordance with price statistics collected by Antaike, the average quotation of antimony ingot (2#) in February 2013 was 67,400-68,400yuan/t. The average price was 67,900yuan/t, up by 0.6% m-o-m and down by 15.2% y-0-y. In Feb., 2013, the quotation of MB standard Ⅱ antimony and low bismuth-antimony was maintained in the range of US$10,700-11,200/t and US$10,800-11,300/t. The average price of standard Ⅱ antimony in February was US$10,700-11,200/t, down by 1.9% m-o-m and 13.7% y-o-y. After Spring Festival, partial smelters of antimony opened operation. As the supply of antimony concentrate was tight and its price was high, purchase activity and order forms in antimony concentrate market was rare. The overseas and domestic antimony market demand in February remained weak. The domestic down-stream antimony consumption enterprises’ demand for antimony didn’t turn better. When seeing sufficient stock, most of purchasers were holding watching attitude in order to avoid price dropping,

so transactions are difficult to increase. Overseas antimony market participants are concerning Chinese market’s change and believe the market won’t keep the current situation. It is hoped that Chinese antimony market would become clear after Spring Festival holidays. 

The current antimony market remains in oversupply. Therefore, it still needs time to break the stagnant situation. 

##### **Policies** 

On Feb. 16, 2013, National Development and Reform Commission issued a determination to revise industry structure adjustment guidance content. According to which, Greenfield and expansion W, Mo, Sn, Sb mining and smelting projects will be listed in restriction projects. 

##### **Import and Export Import** 

In accordance with statistics released by China Customs, China imported 6,026t antimony products in January 2013, down by 8.96% m-o-m and up by 41.22% y-o-y. The import of antimony concentrate in Jan. was about 5,560t, down by 11.58% m-o-m and up by 57.78% y-o-y. The antimony concentrate was mainly imported from Russia, Australia, Burma and Tajikistan in Jan. 2013, respectively being 1,267t, 1,057t, 1,040t and 855t, accounting for 75.9% of the total. 

##### **Export** 

In accordance with statistics released by China Customs, China imported 3,064t antimony products in January, down by 47.43% m-o-m and down by 20.42% y-o-y. Antimony oxide, antimony ingot and antimony sulfide are major exported products. 

In Jan. 2013, the export of antimony oxide was 2,540t, down by 41.38% m-o-m and down by 30.71% y-o-y. It was mainly exported to USA, China Taiwan, Japan and China Hong Kong, respectively being 1,055t, 648t, 330t and 212t, accounting for 88.4% of the total. 

In Jan., the export of unwrought antimony was about 470t, down by 68.01% m-o-m. It was mainly exported to the Netherlands, USA, China Hong Kong, South Korea, respectively being 250t, 80t, 60t and 40t, accounting for 91.5% of the total export. 

Seen from which, Chinese antimony products export in January obviously decreased, especially for the antimony oxide, seeing the largest decrease scale. Seen from the statistics,

##### **Outlook** 

Up to now, the general antimony market supply and demand has not seen fundamental changes, especially when the down-stream demand is resuming. The stagnant market and unclear trend made more market participants waver in determination. Overseas market concerns a lot about Chinese market how to change. By considering the inactive Chinese market now, overseas purchasers hold cautious attitude. 

After Chinese New Year, the domestic antimony market didn’t resume as expected. Overseas antimony market price and demand were maintained steady. The global economy is resuming. European Debt Crisis and USA Financial Crisis have not been solved, but partial economy field started to turn better. 

A

ntaike believes the antimony market in Mar. is difficult to become more active. The down-stream demand still needs a period time to recover. The domestic antimony concentrate supply remains tight and the price remains strong, which will form support for the antimony market. The antimony price is predicted to be steady. It is estimated the whole antimony market will fluctuate in high and narrow scale. The domestic antimony ingot (99.65%) price is forecasted to be around 68,000yuan/t, while the international standard II antimony price would be around US$11,000/t. 

# **<u>Cobalt Market Overview</u>** 

### **Domestic Market** 

#### **Market review** 

Affected by the Chinese Spring Festival Vacation in February, the global cobalt market was silent relatively, and the demand from end using fields almost maintained unchanged. In that case, the global cobalt price was stable in early and middle February. In last of the month, Chinese market participators came back to the market, which made the market worry about potential excessive supply, which led to a decline of the cobalt price. On domestic market, the cobalt spot price was stable too in February, and there was almost no gap between domestic and overseas prices. The monthly average Chinese cobalt quotation was 210,000yuan/t in February.

#### **Export** 

The export of refined cobalt and power was 198t in January, 2013, down by 6.6%; the export of cobalt salts was 565t, u

p by 124% y-o-y. The tetroxide export was 486t, accounting for 86% of total cobalt export. 

#### **Outlook** 

The end users purchased a batch of cobalt material in January, which will use the stocks rather than purchase more in a short term. Meanwhile, the supply from Ambatovy, Ramu and other cobalt projects will become more and more, which causes a worry about over much supply. It is estimated the cobalt price will be in a relative low level in the coming month, and will be strong possible to slip further. 

# **<u>Indium Market Overview</u>** 

##### **Indium** 

After fluctuating for a relative long term, the domestic indium price climbed slowly recently. Usually, the indium price is in uptrend in spring of a year, but the growth space is limited. 

At the end of February, the domestic refined indium quotation was RMB 3,550-3,600/kg, up by RMB 50/kg or 1.42% m-o-m. Meanwhile, the crude indium quotation was RMB 3,300-3,350/kg, up by RMB 90/kg or 2.78% m-o-m. The Chinese FOB quotation of refined indium was US$ 540-580/kg, up by US$ 25/kg or 4.67% m-o-m. 



**Indium products quotation by Indium, Bismuth & Germanium Branch of CNIA** 

Website: www.antaike.com

There were 3 key reasons led to the growth of indium price: 

Firstly, the domestic crude indium smelters suspended production during Spring Festival Holidays. As a result, the crude indium supply became tight, and was in uptrend. Refined indium producers disclosed they were still using the raw material stocks when they just came back to work after the Spring Festival Holidays, and would soon purchase a batch of crude indium. The settlement price of crude indium was at about RMB 3,350/kg. 

Secondly, the traders and investors came back to indium market after the festival, which brought more inquires. Investors brought refined indium at the price of RMB 3,600/kg, and expected the price to climb to RMB 3,800/kg. 

Thirdly, the growth of overseas indium price encouraged the domestic price. The overseas refined indium quotation increased by US$ 85/kg or 18.89% to US$ 535/kg by the end of February from US$ 450/kg at the beginning of the year. 

The latest Customs statistics show that the indium export was still difficult, while the import increased rapidly. The indium export was zero in January, while the data was only 1 kg in December of 2012. On the contrary, the import was 7,404 kg in January, up by 3,658% y-o-y and down by 39.92% m-o-m. Among all indium products, the unwrought refined indium import quantity was 7,252 kg, while the wrought indium was 152 kg. The import brought a stress on domestic indium market. 

However, the real demand from overseas market was much weak than domestic market participators’ anticipation. The domestic investing demand could absorb the excessive indium supply. But, the price growth will not go on in a long term without the support of real consumption. The Chinese TFT-LCD plate capacity

is developing fast, and some enterprises are engaged in R&D of upstream raw materials.
